documentTitle: Meta "code 10" permission errors: stop guessing, ask 3 questions

slides.headline: Meta "code 10": stop guessing.
slides.sub: "You don't have the required permission to access this profile."
mono: "You don't have the required permission to access this profile."

slides.headline: Why it's confusing
slides.body: The error names the symptom. It never names the identity or the missing link.

slides.headline:
Question 1,
who is the token?
slides.body: Check which user or system user it really belongs to. Test tokens and real system users are different identities.

slides.headline:
Question 2,
what can it reach?
slides.body: Which Pages, with which tasks (for example, advertise only, or full).

slides.headline:
Question 3,
what will the ad account promote?
slides.gradient: what will the ad account promote?
slides.body: If that list is empty, a creative naming your Page will fail.

slides.headline: The trap
slides.body: A Page assigned in Business Manager is not the same as a Page linked to the ad account.
